Summary of Police Report re Able Seaman George
E.C. Redman, deserter from H.M.S. "Cumberland".
------------------
Reference to letter, dated May 9, received from
the Captain of H.M.S. "Suffolk", Redman was interviewed
on May 23 at the British Military Detention Camp, Yu Yuen
Road and stated that he believed the letter in question
was in the Detention Store Room. A search was made of
his property and the letter, which reads as follows,
found: "Have received your cablegram, but do not understand
it, please send further particulars; signed Frank".
It was ascertained that about January 6, Redman and Bull
(also a deserter) were introduced to Mr. Morgan,
manager of the International Country Club, No. 500 Rue
Cardinal Mercier, as down and out Britishers. The
following day, Redman requested Mr. Morgan to furnish
the cost of a cablegram to London, promising to repay
the money later. A cablegram to the following effect
was copied into Bentley's code and sent on January 8:
"To Mr. Buck, Piggot Street, London. Am down and out.
Please send some money. Urgent. Signed George".
The reply was to be sent to Mr. Morgan's office, no
reply however was received. From the aforementioned
date, Redman borrowed various sums of money from
Mr. Morgan, amounting to approximately $100.00, it
was also ascertained that Redman and Bull had obtained
various sums of money from Mr. Thomas of No. 35 MacGregor
Road.
The letter belonging to Redman which he
stated was in possession of Detective Sergeant Stocks
was forwarded to A.B. Townrow of H.M.S. Suffolk at his
(Redman's) request at the time of his arrest. This letter
bore the Nanking post mark.

关于皇家海军“坎伯兰”号（H.M.S. "Cumberland"）逃兵、一等水兵乔治·E.C.雷德曼（George E.C. Redman）的警务报告摘要。
------------------
参照5月9日收到的皇家海军“萨福克”号（H.M.S. "Suffolk"）舰长的来信，雷德曼于5月23日在愚园路英国军事拘留营接受讯问，并表示他认为该信件位于拘留营储物室内。对其财物进行了搜查，找到了如下内容的信件：“已收到你的电报，但不明白其意，请提供更多详情；署名弗兰克”。
经查实，约在1月6日，雷德曼和布尔（Bull，亦为逃兵）被介绍给麦根路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）500号国际乡村俱乐部（International Country Club）经理摩根先生（Mr. Morgan），称其为落魄的英国人。次日，雷德曼请求摩根先生垫付发往伦敦的电报费，承诺日后偿还。一份大致如下的电报被抄录进本特利密码（Bentley's code）并于1月8日发出：“致伦敦皮戈特街（Piggot Street）巴克先生（Mr. Buck）。我身无分文，陷入困境。请汇些钱来。急。署名乔治”。
回信应寄至摩根先生办公室，但未收到任何回复。自上述日期起，雷德曼向摩根先生借得若干款项，总额约为100.00美元；还查实雷德曼和布尔从麦格雷戈路（MacGregor Road）35号的托马斯先生（Mr. Thomas）处也获得了若干款项。
雷德曼声称由警佐斯托克斯（Detective Sergeant Stocks）持有的一封属于他的信件，在他被捕时经其要求转交给了皇家海军“萨福克”号的A.B.汤罗（A.B. Townrow）。该信件盖有南京邮戳。

Sir,
The three addresses namely; 99 Stanislas Chevalier; 12 Hwa-
Avenue, Bubbling Well Road; No.12 Kungping Road where Redman
boarded prior to his arrest, were visited on the 23-5-31, but
it was ascertained that no mail had been received at any of the
above addresses for Redman. On 23-5-31 the undersigned visited
the British Military Detention Camp, Yu Yuen Road and again
interviewed Redman. I questioned him as to the letter he received
from his uncle in answer to the cablegramm, he stated that he
received the letter whilst residing at No.99 Stanislas Chevalier,
believed it was now in his belongings in the Detention Store
Room, a search was made of his kit and the letter was found. The
contents of the letter reads, "Have received your cablegramm,
but do not understand it, please send further particulars, signed
Frank." Further questioning of Redman revealed that from the
time Mr. Morgan sent the cablegramm, he had received or borrowed
from Morgan various sums of money amounting approximately to
$100.00.
On the 24-5-31 a visit was paid to the International Country
Club, No.500 Rue Cardinal Mercier, of which place Mr. Morgan is
manager. (This is a gambling resort and at the time of my visit,
heavy gambling was going on). An interview was obtained with
Mr. Morgan who upon being questioned made the following state-
ment:- On or about the 6th of January Redman and Bull were
introduced to Morgan at No.500 Rue Cardinal Mercier by one of the
patrons of his club as down and out Britishers, and requested
to give them any assistance he could, as he was very busy, he
was unable to attend to them, but told them to see him on the
following morning at his residence, No.1 Route des Sources. The

cablegramm. Upon being told no, he told Morgan that he had had
nothing to eat for two days, could he give him any assistance,
whereupon Morgan gave Redman $20.00. From that day on, Redman
visited Morgan at frequent intervals either at his home or
at the club and repeated the same request as described above.
In the middle of January Redman came to Morgan and told him that
he had received an answer from his uncle and also some money,
which he produced, but stated that his uncle would not send any
more money until he received further particulars. (when questioned
Redman did not mention this). Redman continued calling upon
Morgan until his arrest and on each occasion would received $5
or $10.00. From further enquiries made by the undersigned it
was ascertained that Redman and Bull had also play upon the

Sir,
The letter referred to (which bore the Nanking Post Mark) was delivered to me by the houseboy of No.12 Kungping Road, (where Redman was residing prior to his arrest), I in turn forwarded the letter to A. B. Townrow of the H.M.S. Suffolk as requested by Redman at the time of his arrest.

On the 15-5-31 I obtained an interview with the Co-Commissioner of Posts, Mr. Chang and requested that any returned mail, in the name of Redman or Goodchild, be forwarded to the British Military Detention Camp, Yu Yuen Road, this he promised to do. On the 19-5-31 the attached letter was received from the Postal Authorities, stating that they could not trace any mail matter bearing the two above names.

On the 16-5-31 the undersigned and D.S. Black proceeded to Yu Yuen Road Detention Barracks and obtained permission to interview Redman. Upon being questioned Redman stated that at the time he deserted he had very little money, and was obliged to request assistance from a Mr. Jerry Morgan.

Redman wrote the draft of the cablegramm to his uncle at No.99 Staneslas Chevalier on the 7th of January and gave it to Morgan to send on the 8th of January, which he believes Morgan sent via the Great Northern Telegraph Company, No.4 The Bund. Redman alleges that he received a letter in answer to the cablegramm which stated that "money was being sent" in what form or the amount Redman does not know. Redman was unable to produce the letter saying that he had mislaid it somewhere.

On the 17-5-31 I interviewed Mr. Anderson, Supt. of The Great Northern Telegraph Company and requested confirmation of Redman's statement. Mr. Anderson stated that it was against order to impart

Onboard:
HMS Suffolk
at Shanghai May 8th 1931.

To whom it may concern : —

I cabled home for money, I am my friend, and
addressed cable "Lombard", in San Francisco.
I was living at 12 Bubbling Well Rd
under the name of J. Goodchild.
Received reply from cable in form of letter, on
March 1st and date of posting in London was
February 6th. Letter stated Hodgman could not be
on remittance, but was sending me money.
Today: Learning that it was obvious I needed
money and it was being forwarded the
same day namely February 6th as ackt of
postage of letter which I received on March 14th.
From time of receipt of this letter of March 14th
up till time of writing I have had no
further news, and no money.
Household of man, family & two daughters
and an old able woman of Miss Cornwall.
namely Mrs Creighton have sworn that.
I was expecting this money on amount
after £20 or maybe less, so the
letter said "am sending you some
money all I can at present."
Since being turned out to British Police
I am prone to believe that I was given
some money by somebody in that house, who
knowing my bitter position, a deserta from
HMS Cumberland, and that I was expecting
this aforepaid money, saw the only way
to put me out of the way was to give
Police my address. I was only at Bubbling
Well address for a fortnight during the
month of January. From there I went to
pages.zh:
在舰上：
萨福克号（HMS Suffolk）
1931年5月8日于上海。

致有关人士：—

我已向国内发电报汇款，我是我的朋友，并将电报地址写为旧金山的“Lombard”。
我以 J. Goodchild 的名字住在静安寺路12号。
3月1日收到以信件形式回复的电报，其在伦敦的寄出日期为2月6日。信中指出霍奇曼（Hodgman）无法办理汇款，但正在给我寄钱。
今日：得知显然我需要钱，且款项已于同日即2月6日汇出，此系根据我于3月14日收到的信件的邮戳日期确认。
自3月14日收到此信起直至撰写本文时止，我再无进一步消息，也未收到钱款。
该男子的家属、两个女儿以及康沃尔小姐（Miss Cornwall）家的一位年老能干的女佣，即克雷顿夫人（Mrs Creighton），均已宣誓证实此事。
我预计这笔钱数额在20英镑左右或可能更少，因此信中说“现正尽我所能给你寄些钱。”
自从被移交给英国警察后，我倾向于相信是那所房子里的某个人给了我一些钱，此人知晓我的艰难处境——我是从坎伯兰号（HMS Cumberland）逃出的逃兵——并且知道我在等待这笔预付款项，认为让我消失的唯一办法就是向警方提供我的地址。在一月份期间，我只在静安寺路的地址住了两周。从那里我去了

pages.en:
99 Stanislas Chevalier. Avenue Goffre. and
I also expect mail there in the name of
J. Woodchild. or G. Redman. From there
I went to the Wing Lung Bank East Broadway
where I was arrested. And I expect mail
there in the name of Redman.
On April 1st while at Ningpung Road, I
sent letter to my Uncle asking for such
particulars as to where money had
been sent or not. If it had. When!
In what form of currency! Registration
No. if Registered! date if dispatched!
above addressed. and any further
particulars in order to clear up
the mystery of why I never got a reply
such inquiry. Receiving this the sender
had told me "He was forwarding on
some money."
I expect a reply from my Uncle in answer
to my letter of 1st inst. of April, about
the end of May or thereabouts; and
it should clear up everything.
I accuse nobody of 'knobbling' their food,
but I have suspicions. I base my
suspicions on proposals placed
before me to leave Shanghai
by Mr. Creighton, and also the manner
in which he has answered, and
evaded questions put to him by me,
concerning letters. The undersigned was living
with me from time I took residence at Basking Villa
and can verify my statements.
Writer of above George E. G. Redman
Witness to this Statement - Henry Bull.
pages.zh:
戈费雷路（Avenue Goffre）斯坦尼斯拉斯·谢瓦利埃路（Stanislas Chevalier）99号。
我也在那里以 J. Woodchild 或 G. Redman 的名义接收邮件。从那里我去了百老汇东路的永隆银行（Wing Lung Bank），并在那里被捕。我在那里以 Redman 的名义接收邮件。
4月1日，当我在宁平路（Ningpung Road）时，我给我的叔叔寄了一封信，询问钱款是否已汇出等具体细节。如果已汇出，何时汇出？以何种货币形式？如挂号，挂号编号是多少？如已发出，日期为何？以上均请赐复，并提供任何进一步细节，以便澄清我为何从未收到此类查询回复的谜团。收到此信后，发件人曾告诉我“他正在汇出一些钱。”
我预计在五月底左右收到我叔叔对我4月1日去信的回复；那应该能澄清一切。
我不指控任何人“偷吃”他们的食物，但我有所怀疑。我的怀疑基于克雷顿先生（Mr. Creighton）向我提出的离开上海的建议，以及他回答和回避我关于信件问题的方式。下述签署人自从我入住巴斯金别墅（Basking Villa）起便与我同住，可以证实我的陈述。
上述文字作者 乔治·E·G·雷德曼（George E. G. Redman）
本声明见证人 - 亨利·布尔（Henry Bull）。
